en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view over a riverside town with houses in the foreground, a broad river with boats and barges to the left, and wooded hills in the background. The foreground looks like it is taken from an elevated viewpoint above the town. Printed captions in German identify the scene as Meissen and indicate that the view is from the Bergschlösschen (Rudolph's Weinstuben). The publisher's imprint appears along the bottom edge.
